translation.hint: The bot auto-translates between the two selected languages. Translations appear in a companion tab as text and via Voxtral TTS as audio.

audio.costWarning: Costs Voxtral TTS per generated audio second — typically €0.90 per meeting hour.

welcome: Reminder: even geniuses are allowed to copy-paste.
Today is for productive work, with style and zero stress.
Your ideas are ready. The text turbo is already warming up.
Plan for today: less chaos, more clarity.
When words run, we line them up neatly.
A good day to turn notes into results.
transcription: We're listening intently and capturing every word.
The audio turbo is warming up. Please don't blink.
Mic bits are being turned into clean readable text.
Words are being collected like coins in a jump-and-run.
Brushing through the audio, then the text stands neatly arranged.
Audio in the spa programme — it returns shortly as text.
ocr: Reading pixel by pixel so no word gets lost.
Each character is greeted before lining up.
Translating paper logic into screen logic.
Scanner caffeinated. Text is on its way.
translation: Bridging: words are being lifted to the other side.
Sentences are being dressed for their new language.
Meaning before literal — every line gets its translation.
textOptimization: Smoothing sentences without losing their character.
Stylish polish — every sentence will sparkle in a moment.
Your text is getting a touch-up.
